-## reference · Wikidata notability criteria
-* An item is acceptable if it fulfills at least one of Wikidata's two main goals: to centralize interlanguage links or to serve as a general knowledge base.
-* An item meets the criteria if it has at least one valid sitelink to a page on Wikipedia, Wikivoyage, Wikisource, Wikiquote, Wikinews, Wikibooks, Wikidata, Wikispecies, Wikiversity, or Wikimedia Commons.
-* A valid sitelink must not be a:
-  + Talk page
-  + Page in MediaWiki namespace
-  + Special page
-  + File
-  + Translations page
-  + Page in User or Draft namespace
-  + Page used by LiquidThreads
-  + Page used by Structured Discussions
-  + Subpage of Portal namespace
-  + Page intended for TemplateStyles
-* In case of disagreement over the notability of an item, a request for deletion can be launched.
